chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Ali ibn Atiyya, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), saying: 'We buy food from the ships, then we measure it, and it increases.' So he (peace be upon him) said to me: 'And sometimes it is less upon you.' I said, 'Yes.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'So when it is less, do they return the deficiency to you?' I said, 'No.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no problem (with the increase as well).'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to keep extra food if the seller does not return the missing amount?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) rules that if food bought from ships is measured and found to be more than expected, it is permissible to keep the excess even if the deficiency is not returned by the seller. This establishes the permissibility of keeping the surplus in trade measurements when the shortfall is not compensated. This ruling highlights the principle of 'ease' (yusr) in commercial transactions, distinguishing between strict contractual obligation and customary practice in bulk trade, reflecting the Shia emphasis on fairness without undue hardship.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Atiyya who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying, ‘We buy the foodstuff from the ships, then we measure it, so it is more’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘And sometimes it is less upon you’. I said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So when it is less, do they return you the deficiency?’ I said, ‘No’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem (with the increase as well)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr ibn ‘ Atiyyah who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of our buying food from ships.

We then measure and find extra amount. He (the Imam) said, ‘Perhaps you find it to be less also.’ I replied, ‘Yes, that also happens.’ He (the Imam) then asked, ‘Do they give you the deficit?’ I replied, ‘No, they do not give the deficit. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful.’”
